svg.aria-label: Final schematic of the solar charger selector
svg.text: SOLAR CHARGER SELECTOR — FINAL SCHEMATIC (as built)
Dots are connections; wires that cross without a dot (or with a hop) are not connected. ⏚ = control GND.
A · PV SIDE — one relay per controller switches PV+; PV− goes to every controller (common-negative controllers only)
LOAD set to 24 h / always on
Inside each common-negative controller PV− = BAT− = LOAD−, so ⏚ (control GND) = PV−.
Check each controller with a meter: PV− and BAT− must beep together.
B · CONTROL — Arduino Uno and the proto shield
Only one relay is ever on. Every change: all relays off for 10 s, then one relay on. Each relay coil has its own 1N4007 (stripe to +12 V).
Relay contacts K1/K3/K5 must be rated for the array's cold Voc in DC. Divider R18: 220k for Voc up to ~110 V, 330k up to ~160 V (set R_TOP_K in the sketch).
Battery voltage sensing (A0–A2) is not used in this version: a full battery is detected from the panel voltage on A5.
